text: Tokens in the proposed DAO function as reputation because an agent's proportional token holdings will grow over time only if that agent follows sound and successful underwriting practices.
citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Vadhindran K. Rao, Decentralized Underwriting (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3396542
abstract: We will refer to these tokens on occasion as reputation tokens as an agent's proportional holdings of these tokens is likely to increase over time only if the agent were to follow sound and successful underwriting practices.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: tokens are minted as rewards for staking on underwritten policies
